newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank shares rose on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday with Audi shares up to $16 from at $15.875 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares also up to $12.25 from $12.
Solidere A rose to $10.5 from its low of $10.25 while B shares held steady at $11.125.
Turnover in Audi, which began trading at $15 last week, fell to 20,500 shares from 33,000. Only 500 BLC shares changed hands compared to 2,000 a day earlier.
Banque Audi and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce are the first two Lebanese banks listed on the BSE since it reopened in January 1996.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover fell to 97,694 shares from 131,898. Value was $1,157,769 against $1,595,474.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.9 percent to 914.63 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.27 percent to 81.33.
